title: i18n: a published org overlay on a packaged view label is served to a zh-CN reader as the catalog translation (进行中), not the edit — the view twin of #20680
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a measured `reach:`**. Finding class **(a)**. `reach:` is `GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress` and `GET /api/v1/meta/view` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN`, after a published org overlay. The #20680 dev measured them in a real showcase boot, as an admin and as a member of the same org, on PR #20728's branch build (`os-dev-report` 5900307018 on #20680, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`, probe3). The readings are the dev's; the seat did not re-run them.

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01DEvba2nBuD4tWzfq8r8NFY`, `os-support-ai`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: triage, then the seat of the lane that owns the spec translator (`packages/spec` `i18n-resolver.ts`) and the `/meta` doors.

## What happens

- An org overlay changes the packaged view `showcase_task.in_progress`'s label to `In Progress (edited-20680)` and is published.
- An `en` reader is served the edit.
- A `zh-CN` reader, admin or member, on the item read and the list read, is served `进行中`: the catalog's translation of the shipped label, not the edit.
- A reset restores `In Progress`.

ADR-0126 Regime O makes packaged views and dashboards "yours to edit directly". A `zh-CN` org never sees its own edit.

## Why

It is the same family as #20680: the i18n catalog (`objects.<object>._views.<view_key>.label`) is applied over the served document with no packaged base to compare against. So the catalog wins over an authored label, which is the opposite of what ADR-0029 D9.2a records for objects ("an explicit override beats a packaged default", the #8284 comparison). PR #20728 teaches `translateDashboard` that comparison, and the dashboard `/meta` threading is #20730. Neither covers views.

## Scope for whoever takes it

- The view translator applies the same comparison when handed the packaged view, and the `/meta` view item and list reads hand it that base.
- **Pins:** the reading above, as an admin and as a member, on item and list, in `en` and `zh-CN`. An unedited view stays translated, and a reset restores the shipped label.
- Views translate by composer-derived keys under `_views`, so check the key the base is matched by (the dev's note).

## Dedupe

`search_issues` in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, open and closed:
- "view label overlay zh-CN translation wins over org overlay translateView": 5 hits. #4854 (view labels never resolved a translation, closed) is the nearest, and none is an overlay losing to the catalog.
- "explicit override beats packaged default translation catalog object label overlay": 4 hits, none about views.

Dedupe words: `view overlay translation catalog` · `translateView packagedBase` · `_views label overlay zh-CN` · `Regime O overlay i18n`
